question: Choose the correct **one-word substitute** for: 'The study of coins and medals'.
solution: The correct answer is: **Numismatics**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Numismatics"** refers to the study or collection of coins, currency, and medals. (सिक्कों और पदकों का अध्ययन) • **Example:** His passion for numismatics led him to collect rare ancient coins from different civilizations. • Now, let's understand the word **"Numismatics"** in detail: • English meaning: The academic study or collection of coins, tokens, paper money, and related objects. • Hindi meaning: सिक्कों, टोकन, कागजी मुद्रा और संबंधित वस्तुओं का अध्ययन। • **Example:** The numismatics exhibition showcased coins from the Roman Empire and medieval India. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Numismatics**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Cartography** (मानचित्रण): The study and practice of making maps. • **Example:** Cartography played a crucial role in the exploration of new territories during the Age of Discovery. • **Epigraphy** (शिलालेख विद्या): The study of inscriptions or epigraphs as writing; it is the science of identifying graphemes. • **Example:** The archaeologist studied ancient scripts through the field of epigraphy. • **Cryptography** (गुप्तलेखन): The art of writing or solving codes. • **Example:** Cryptography ensures secure communication in modern digital systems. 3f:T6f1, The correct answer is **option 3.**
